verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms Weaviate publishes an llms.txt at docs.weaviate.io/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with an agent-oriented TL;DR summary of the product, so an agent can be pointed at it directly. The MCP server evidence belongs to a separate story and is not credited here. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the llms.txt or other agent-oriented docs (scope, an llms-full.txt or per-page markdown variants), and independent corroboration of how complete or useful the file is for agents.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
